sections.title: Bottles
sections.note: Four in all. Swing an empty one to catch fairies, bugs, fish and Big Poes.

items.name: Cucco Lady's bottle
items.howTo: As young Link, carry all seven of the Cucco Lady's Cuccos back into her pen by the village entrance.
items.notes: Some are behind fences or up on ledges: throw them over, or glide down holding one. Bringing them back again pays a Purple Rupee.

items.name: Talon's Chicken Game
items.howTo: As young Link, pay Talon in the ranch house to play, and find his three Super Cuccos among the others before time runs out.
items.notes: Throw the ordinary Cuccos behind Talon's desk before you start, so only the Super Cuccos are left to find.

items.name: Ruto's Letter
items.howTo: With the Silver Scale, dive for the bottle on the lake bed near the underwater passage to Zora's Domain.
items.notes: Show the letter to King Zora to get into Zora's Fountain; he lets you keep the bottle.

items.name: Poe Collector
items.howTo: As adult Link, sell 10 Big Poes to the Poe Collector in the Ghost Shop, the old guardhouse by the Market entrance.
items.notes: Each Big Poe pays 50 Rupees and 100 points; the bottle comes at 1,000 points. The Big Poes tracker lists all ten.
